guide.title: Guest guide

guide.securityNotice: Current limit: links and QRs already shared can't be revoked or limited to a stay, and don't expire. They never contain access details. Revocation and per-stay links depend on the database (not live yet).
guide.demoNotice: The guide content is embedded in the link so it opens on any phone. This link doesn't expire and can't be revoked, so it never contains access details. Guest reports and requests will only reach you once the database is live.
